verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping SaaS, so asking whether it ships an official CLI is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows one. Every documented customer surface is web or in-app: account connections, categorization, report downloads and messaging the bookkeeping team. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so there is also no sign of a developer or programmatic surface a CLI could build on.
